note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because raw `meta` shapes vary between rounds: the datasets-server infers `meta` from the thin `{factory, generator, round}` records in `batch-r01.jsonl`, then cannot cast the later records that add `kind`, `seed`, `designed`, `domain`, `stack` and `lane`. Declaring the union — with `meta`, `reward` and `tool_call.args` as `json` — fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present on all 322 records as a non-empty string; it is not optional in this dataset

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool (`bash`, `fetch`, `read`, `pytest`, `edit`, `grep`, `write`)

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success`, `tests_passed`, `cost_steps` on every record, plus `retries`, `duration_min`, `wasted_calls` on 312 of 322, `plan_changes` on 310 of 322, `handoff` on 4 and `xfailed` on 2

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record, plus `kind`, `seed`, `designed`, `domain`, `stack` on 312 of 322 and `lane` on 12 of 322

disclosures.summary: Ten records carry the thin `meta` `{factory, generator, round}` that the other 312 records extend with `kind`, `seed`, `designed`, `domain` and `stack`. Two of them sit in `batch-r01.jsonl`, so they are the shape the inferred schema is built from and the reason the later cast fails. They are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: Twelve records from rounds 4 through 10 additionally carry `meta.lane` (always the string `b`), which no other record has. Their `reward` omits `plan_changes` and instead reports `retries`, `duration_min` and `wasted_calls`.

Every record is a `websocket-reconnect-factory` episode generated by `grok-4.6`, carries a `wsr-` id, and no id repeats across the 161 shards. The published records exhibit this factory's advertised leftover-resume / reconnect mechanic, but this declaration does not infer generator-file provenance from that naming. Within this dataset there is no foreign-factory stamp and no dest-stamped foreign payload.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
